project.name: SQLAlchemyLesson
project.summary: A script-only ORM lesson creates a user table, inserts three demonstration users and prints assigned IDs. There is no interactive menu, relationship implementation or HTTP service.

nodes.label: User schema
nodes.summary: User declares id, name, fullname and nickname columns on a declarative Base.

nodes.label: Demonstration transaction
nodes.summary: The main guard creates tables, adds three User objects, commits and prints IDs.

nodes.label: SQLite database
nodes.summary: Engine and session target a working-directory SQLite file; data is not read for this map.

nodes.label: Project reference and license
nodes.summary: Original course documentation and any upstream license remain separate from executable processing.
